children: Teledyne Energetics UK, a subsidiary of Teledyne Technologies Incorporated
with a European defence technology manufacturer to supply specialist energetics products for advanced unmanned systems.
The agreement establishes a long-term supply framework with potential total value exceeding $50M as production requirements scale.
Teledyne will deliver advanced initiation and energetic solutions designed for compact, high-reliability applications in next-generation European drone platforms.
The award reinforces Teledyne's role as a key technology partner in expanding sovereign European defense manufacturing capabilities and supply-chain resilience for unmanned systems.
Deliveries under the agreement will begin immediately to support ongoing development activity, with expectations of expanded volume as production increases.

title: Teledyne Technologies subsidiary awarded $15.4M contract to supply advanced drone energetics in Europe
